es: Formular concesiones condicionadas y contraofertas con provided that, as long as, unless y otherwise en una negociación de ocho turnos.

teaching.en: I can concede the parking place, provided that you pay the deposit this week.
teaching.es: Puedo ceder el aparcamiento, siempre que pagues el depósito esta semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that + condición en presente: la concesión vale solo si se cumple.
segments: I can concede the parking place, provided
that you pay the deposit this week.
teaching.audioText: I can concede the parking place, provided that you pay the deposit this week.

teaching.en: I will concede a fixed rent for next year as long as you stay for two years.
teaching.es: Te concedo un alquiler fijo para el año próximo mientras te quedes dos años.
teaching.explanationEs: As long as + presente (no will): condición que debe mantenerse.
segments: I will concede a fixed rent for next year
as long as you stay for two years.
teaching.audioText: I will concede a fixed rent for next year as long as you stay for two years.

teaching.en: We will not sign unless the heating is repaired.
teaching.es: No firmaremos a menos que se repare la calefacción.
teaching.explanationEs: Unless = if not: ya es negativo, el verbo siguiente no lleva not.
teaching.audioText: We will not sign unless the heating is repaired.

teaching.en: Pay on the first of the month; otherwise, we will review the contract.
teaching.es: Paga el día uno del mes; de lo contrario, revisaremos el contrato.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise anuncia la consecuencia si no se cumple la condición.
segments: Pay on the first of the month;
otherwise, we will review the contract.
teaching.audioText: Pay on the first of the month; otherwise, we will review the contract.

teaching.en: That is too high, so here is my counteroffer: 880 a month, with the deposit in two parts.
teaching.es: Eso es demasiado, así que esta es mi contraoferta: 880 al mes, con el depósito en dos partes.
teaching.explanationEs: Counteroffer responde a una oferta con otra propia.
segments: That is too high, so here is my counteroffer:
880 a month, with the deposit in two parts.
teaching.audioText: That is too high, so here is my counteroffer: 880 a month, with the deposit in two parts.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa una concesión condicionada bien construida?

choices.text: I will give you the parking place provided that you will pay on time.
I will give you the parking place provided you to pay on time.
I will give you the parking place provided that you pay on time.

feedback.es: Tras provided that el verbo va en presente: pay, no will pay.

hint.es: Tras provided that el verbo va en presente.

prompt.es: Completa: «No firmaremos a menos que arreglen la calefacción.»

feedback.es: Unless equivale a «si no»: no firmamos si no arreglan la calefacción.

origin.text: We will not sign ___ you fix the heating.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Mi contraoferta es pagar 900 al mes.»

answer.text: My counteroffer is to pay 900 a month

feedback.es: Counteroffer + is to + verbo base presenta tu propuesta alternativa.

hint.es: Empieza con My counteroffer is to.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases con la conjunción adecuada.

feedback.es: Provided that y as long as piden que se cumpla la condición; unless exige que ocurra algo para no firmar.

sentences: I will concede the date, ___ that you confirm today.
We will not sign ___ the contract includes the repairs.
The rent stays the same ___ you keep the flat clean.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué pasa si el cliente quiere la entrega incluida.

choices.text: The price does not go down.
The price goes down fifty dollars.

feedback.es: Con la entrega incluida no hay descuento: «unless» anula la rebaja de cincuenta dólares.

origin.audio: I can drop the price by fifty dollars, unless you want the delivery included.

choices.text: I can accept 850, provided that the deposit is paid in two parts.

feedback.es: Una contraoferta propone otras cifras o condiciones; las otras dos solo aceptan o rechazan.

origin.text: Offer: «880 a month, with no deposit.»

prompt.es: ¿Qué debe hacer la otra persona para recibir el coche?

feedback.es: «Provided you bring it back before eight» fija la condición: devolverlo antes de las ocho.

origin.text: Mia: «I will lend you my car on Saturday, provided you bring it back before eight.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuándo bajaría el vendedor el precio.

choices.text: If the buyer pays on the day of the sale.
If the buyer waits a month.

feedback.es: «I will not go lower unless you pay on the same day»: solo bajará si se paga ese mismo día.

origin.audio: I will accept 4,200 for the car as long as the tyres are changed, but I will not go lower unless you pay on the same day.

prompt.es: Completa: «Paga a tiempo; de lo contrario, revisaremos el contrato.»

feedback.es: Otherwise anuncia lo que pasa si no se cumple la condición.

origin.text: Pay on time; ___, we will review the contract.

prompt.es: Escribe un diálogo de ocho turnos con dos concesiones condicionadas y una contraoferta.

answer.text: Ana: Hello, Leo. I would like to rent your hall on Saturdays for a small market. I can offer 300 dollars a month. Leo: That is too low. I need 400, because I pay for heating and cleaning. Ana: I understand. Here is my counteroffer: 350 dollars, and we clean the hall after every market. Leo: I can accept 350 as long as you clean it before six in the evening. Ana: Agreed, provided that you give us the keys on Friday night. Leo: I will give you the keys unless there is a private party on Saturday morning. Ana: That is fair, but please tell me by Thursday; otherwise, we will plan the first market for next month. Leo: Deal. I will send you a written agreement tomorrow, and you can sign it on Saturday.

Ana: Good morning. I am interested in your hall for a weekend market, and I can offer 300 dollars a month. Leo: Thank you, but that does not cover my costs. My price is 400. Ana: Let me make a counteroffer: 340 dollars, provided that we may use the kitchen. Leo: You can use the kitchen as long as everything is clean when you leave. Ana: Of course. We will also pay on the first of each month unless you prefer a different day. Leo: The first is perfect, but I need the money on time; otherwise, I will have to raise the price. Ana: Then we agree: 340 a month, kitchen included, clean before six. Leo: Deal. I will write it down tonight.

feedback.es: El diálogo debe alternar oferta, contraoferta y concesiones con provided that, as long as o unless, y cerrar con un acuerdo.

origin.text: Ana quiere alquilar el salón de Leo los sábados para un mercadillo. Ana ofrece 300 dólares al mes y Leo pide 400. Escribe en inglés un diálogo de ocho turnos (Ana y Leo, entre 120 y 240 palabras) con dos concesiones condicionadas (provided that, as long as o unless), una contraoferta y un cierre de acuerdo.
